_comment.about: podman-watchdog configuration. Copy to /etc/podman-watchdog/config.json (mode 0600, root-owned) and set discord.webhookUrl. The real config.json is git-ignored and is the ONLY place the webhook secret lives.
_comment.fastTickSec: Detection cadence (s): fork-free reads of meminfo/pressure/per-container pids + risk evaluation. Calibrated: 5.
_comment.slowTickSec: Enrich cadence (s): podman ps id->name refresh, podman stats, OOM events, log prune. Calibrated: 30.
_comment.pidmax.critPct: Per-container ratio for CRIT. 0.90 => 1843/2048. Must be >= warnPct.
_comment.pidmax.rateProjectTicks: Rate-of-approach: warn early if, at the current per-tick delta, the container is projected to reach pids.max within this many fast ticks. Calibrated: 3.
_comment.pidmax.rateMinRatio: Rate-of-approach only applies once the ratio is at least this. Calibrated: 0.50. (pids.max === 'max' is always EXEMPT from all pidmax/rate alerting.)
_comment.memory.psiSomeAvg10CritPct: 'some avg10=' percent for CRIT. Calibrated: 30. Must be >= warn.
_comment.memory.memAvailWarnBytes: MemAvailable absolute backstop for WARN (bytes). Calibrated: ~12 GiB.
_comment.memory.memAvailCritBytes: MemAvailable absolute backstop for CRIT (bytes). Calibrated: ~5 GiB. Must be <= warn.
_comment.memory.ponrBufferBytes: Buffer added to the parsed earlyoom effective kill threshold to compute the 'point-of-no-return' CRIT line (bytes). Calibrated: 512 MiB.
_comment.cooldownSec: Per (entity, severity) debounce window (s). Escalation warn->crit fires immediately. Calibrated: 300.
_comment.resolveAfterClears: Consecutive clear evaluations before a RESOLVE alert is emitted. Calibrated: 2.
_comment.logRetentionHours: Delete metrics-YYYYMMDD.jsonl files older than this. Calibrated: 48.
_comment.discord.webhookUrl: Discord webhook URL. SECRET. Set only in the real config.json. Leave as REPLACE_ME here.
_comment.discord.retries: POST retry attempts after the first try. On total failure the full alert is logged to stderr (journald). Calibrated: 3.
_comment.discord.backoffMs: Exponential backoff base (ms): waits backoffMs * 2^attempt. Calibrated: 1000.
_comment.paths: Filesystem locations. cgroupRoot is the cgroup v1 pids parent for rootful podman. stateFile is 0644 world-readable (widget contract, no secrets). logDir holds daily JSONL.
